metadata.title: About | Slashie
metadata.description: Slashie is a map-first marketplace for local tasks. Customers post for free, nearby workers send quotes, and Slashie takes no cut of the job.

hero.heading: About Slashie
hero.body: Slashie is a map-first marketplace for local tasks. Post what you need, get quotes from workers nearby, and choose who does the job.

customers.title: If you need a hand
steps: Post your task with where and when. It's free.
Compare quotes from nearby workers, with their reviews.
Choose a worker, get it done, then leave a review.

workers.title: If you do the work
steps: Browse tasks near you on the map.
Send a quote with your price and when you can start.
Do the job, get paid directly, and build your reviews.

points.title: Free for customers
points.body: Posting a task, comparing quotes and choosing a worker cost nothing.

points.title: Free quotes for workers
points.body: Every worker gets free quotes each month. Slashie Unlimited removes the limit.

points.title: No cut of the job
points.body: Customers pay workers directly, outside Slashie. We never take a share of the job.

mission.heading: Why we're building it
mission.body: AI is changing a lot of careers, and not everyone lands on the right side of that shift. We want to help those people find paid work close to home instead of sitting idle. If that brings unemployment down a little, the world gets a little better.

open.heading: Built in the open
open.body: Slashie is open source and built in public by an AI-driven company. Read the code on GitHub, or follow our progress on LinkedIn.

closing.heading: Ready when you are
closing.body: Post a task in a minute, or start quoting on tasks near you.

metadata.title: 關於 | Slashie
metadata.description: Slashie 是以地圖為主的本地任務平台。客戶免費發布任務，附近的工作者報價，Slashie 不會從工作中抽取佣金。

hero.heading: 關於 Slashie
hero.body: Slashie 是以地圖為主的本地任務平台。發布你需要完成的事，收取附近工作者的報價，再選擇由誰來做。

customers.title: 需要幫手時
steps: 寫下任務內容、地點和時間，免費發布。
比較附近工作者的報價和評價。
選定工作者，完成任務後留下評價。

workers.title: 想接工作時
steps: 在地圖上瀏覽附近的任務。
發送報價，寫明價錢和可開始的時間。
完成工作，直接收款，累積評價。

points.title: 客戶免費
points.body: 發布任務、比較報價和選擇工作者，全部免費。

points.title: 工作者每月免費報價
points.body: 每位工作者每月都有免費報價額度；訂閱 Slashie Unlimited 即可無限報價。

points.title: 不抽佣金
points.body: 客戶在 Slashie 以外直接付款給工作者，我們不會從工作中抽取任何佣金。

mission.heading: 我們為何要做 Slashie
mission.body: AI 正在改變很多行業，並非每個人都站在有利的一方。我們希望幫助這些人在附近找到有薪工作，而不是賦閒在家。如果能令失業率降低一點，世界也會好一點。

open.heading: 公開開發
open.body: Slashie 是開源項目，由一間以 AI 驅動的公司公開開發。歡迎到 GitHub 查看程式碼，或在 LinkedIn 追蹤我們的進度。
open.github: 在 GitHub 查看程式碼

closing.heading: 隨時開始
closing.body: 一分鐘發布任務，或開始為附近的任務報價。
